story.label: 01 / THE TERVYX MINDSET
paragraphs: TERVYX Technologies is a software house offering business websites, web applications, mobile app development, UI/UX design in Figma, social media marketing and search engine optimization.

We start with your audience, existing systems and project priorities. Design, features, integrations and content responsibilities are discussed before the scope is agreed, so you can choose one service or a coordinated approach.
